items.description: Upgrade direct dependency pdfkit 0.11.0 -> 0.12.2 (major); pdfkit@0.12.2 requires crypto-js ^4.0.0, which admits a fixed version
items.approved_by: TEST-RUN by Claude (not a real human approval)
items.approval_reason: critical crypto-js weakness reachable via pdfkit (routes/order.ts); upgrade parent pdfkit 0.11 -> 0.12
